## Who is Abdul Basit Shahid?

Abdul Basit Shahid is a Full-Stack Developer and Backend Engineer based in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Software Engineering at COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus, where he is part of the Spring 2025 batch.

Abdul Basit specializes in designing and building scalable backend systems, full-stack web applications, and professional-grade developer tools. His core technology stack centers around Laravel (PHP), Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, React, Next.js, Astro, and Electron.js. He is deeply passionate about Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, Software Architecture, and delivering high-quality software solutions that solve real-world problems.

Beyond coding, Abdul Basit is an advocate for clean code practices, modular architecture, and well-documented systems. He believes in building software that is not only functional but also maintainable, performant, and elegantly designed.

**Connect with Abdul Basit Shahid on LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdul-basit-shahid-9612a5424/

## Complete Technical Skills Profile

### Backend Development (Primary Expertise)
- **Laravel (PHP)**: Expert-level proficiency. Built production-ready applications with complex business logic, role-based access control (RBAC), Eloquent ORM relationships, queue workers, event-driven architecture, and comprehensive API layers. Experienced with Laravel ecosystem tools including Sanctum, Breeze, Horizon, and Sail.
- **Node.js & Express.js**: Proficient in building high-performance REST APIs, real-time applications with WebSockets, stream processing for file handling, and CLI tools. Experienced with middleware patterns, error handling strategies, and async/await patterns.
- **TypeScript**: Type-safe full-stack development across Node.js backends and React frontends. Values TypeScript for catching bugs at compile time and improving developer experience.
- **RESTful API Architecture**: Designs APIs following REST best practices including proper HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, filtering, versioning, and authentication. Experienced with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
- **PostgreSQL**: Advanced query optimization, indexing strategies, migrations, and schema design. Prefers PostgreSQL for its robust type system, JSON support, and advanced features.
- **MySQL**: Production experience with MySQL databases, query optimization, and replication.
- **Docker & Containerization**: Multi-container deployments with Docker Compose, Dockerfile optimization, and containerized development environments.

### Frontend Development
- **React & Next.js**: Component-driven development with hooks, context API, and server-side rendering (SSR). Experienced building interactive UIs with state management solutions.
- **Astro Framework**: Static-first, high-performance website development. Abdul Basit's own portfolio is built with Astro, showcasing his ability to create blazing-fast static sites with partial hydration.
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid, responsive UI development. Proficient in custom theme configuration and component abstraction.
- **HTML5 & CSS3**: Strong foundation in semantic HTML, accessibility (a11y), responsive design, CSS Grid, Flexbox, and CSS animations.

### Desktop Application Development
- **Electron.js**: Built multiple production desktop applications including Drop (drag-and-drop file utility) and TurboDM (multi-threaded download manager). Experienced with Electron's main/renderer process architecture, IPC communication, native OS integrations, and performance optimization.

### DevOps & Tools
- **Git & Version Control**: Proficient in collaborative Git workflows, branching strategies (Git Flow, trunk-based), conflict resolution, and repository management.
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Automated testing and deployment workflows.
- **CLI Development**: Built developer productivity tools and command-line interfaces.

### Computer Science Fundamentals
- **Data Structures & Algorithms**: Strong problem-solving skills with trees, graphs, dynamic programming, sorting algorithms, and complexity analysis.
- **Object-Oriented Programming & Design**: SOLID principles, design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy, Repository), and clean architecture.
- **Software Architecture**: Scalable system design, microservices patterns, event-driven architecture, and domain-driven design.

## Featured Projects — Detailed Case Studies

### 1. FastFood Invoice System
**Type**: Full-Stack Web Application
**Tech Stack**: PHP, Laravel, Blade Templates, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Docker, Docker Compose
**Repository**: https://github.com/basit-shahid/fastfood-invoice-system

A comprehensive invoice management system designed for fast-food restaurant operations. This project demonstrates Abdul Basit's ability to build complete, production-ready web applications with complex business logic.

**Key Features**:
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with distinct admin and cashier roles
- Guest profile management with order history tracking
- OTP-less login system for streamlined authentication
- Complete order billing workflow with itemized invoices
- Docker deployment with multi-container setup (app, database, web server)
- Responsive UI with Blade templating

**Technical Highlights**:
- Clean MVC architecture with service layer patterns
- Database migrations and seeders for reproducible setups
- API endpoints for potential mobile app integration
- Comprehensive validation and error handling

### 2. Drop
**Type**: Desktop Application
**Tech Stack**: JavaScript, Electron.js, HTML5, CSS3
**Repository**: https://github.com/basit-shahid/drop

A minimal, blazing-fast drag-and-drop file utility designed specifically for developers who need instant file transfers without friction.

**Key Features**:
- Instant file transfers via drag-and-drop interface
- Glowing drop zones with visual feedback
- Multi-format file support (documents, images, code files, archives)
- Clean dark UI optimized for developer workflows
- Lightweight footprint with fast startup time

**Technical Highlights**:
- Electron main/renderer process architecture
- Native OS file system integration
- Custom CSS animations for polished UX
- Cross-platform compatibility

### 3. TurboDM
**Type**: Desktop Application (Download Manager)
**Tech Stack**: JavaScript, Electron.js, Node.js, Streams API
**Repository**: https://github.com/basit-shahid/turbodm

A high-performance, professional-grade Download Manager built for Windows. This project showcases Abdul Basit's advanced Node.js skills, particularly in concurrent I/O and stream handling.

**Key Features**:
- Multi-threaded download engine supporting up to 32 parallel connections
- Sleek, neon-inspired dark UI design
- Real-time progress tracking with speed metrics
- Pause, resume, and retry functionality
- Queue management for batch downloads

**Technical Highlights**:
- Advanced Node.js stream handling for high-throughput downloads
- Concurrent HTTP range requests for segmented downloading
- IPC communication between Electron processes
- File integrity verification
- Memory-efficient chunk processing
